lineage: MAR>R@ 7.5 ips>DVD; Akai GX636 (a rare black model) > Apogee Mini Me @24bit/96kHz > Apogee mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One Audio Card > Wavelab 5.0 > FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑energy night captured with solid sound and plenty of Jerry’s pedal‑steel magic, highlighted by a shivering Hard to Handle solo and an epic Other One full of WRS quotes.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the inclusion of the New Riders of the Purple Sage opening set, which gives a true ‘whole‑night’ feel and adds over an hour of Jerry Garcia on pedal steel. The Dead’s second set shines with a spine‑tingling Hard to Handle solo and a memorable Other One where Bob Weir slips in WRS snippets. While one reviewer notes the omission of “Me and Bobby McGee,” the overall impression is that both performance and recording are highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five reviews give 5‑star praise for the show’s energy and standout moments; one low rating notes a missing track but does not detract from overall enjoyment. Recording quality is praised indirectly (full concert feel) though no technical details are given, leading to a solid but not exceptional score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners appreciate the inclusion of the NRPS set for a complete concert experience, suggesting a reasonably balanced mix that captures both bands. No specific comments on clarity or drop‑outs were made.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Full‑night capture that blends the NRPS opening with the Dead’s set; second part of The Other One features Bob Weir quoting the Weather Report Suite, adding a fun surprise.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for his pedal‑steel work with the New Riders and a shivering solo on Hard to Handle that gave listeners goosebumps.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for quoting the Weather Report Suite (WRS) at specific timestamps during The Other One.
